title: Solvable Automorphism Groups of Varieties
summary: Let $X$ be a variety of dimension $n$, and let $\mathrm{Aut}(X)$ be its automorphism group. When $X$ is quasi-affine, we prove that a solvable subgroup of $\mathrm{Aut}(X)$ that is generated by an irreducible family of automorphisms containing the identity is an algebraic subgroup. Our main applications concern arbitrary varieties. First, every connected solvable subgroup of $\mathrm{Aut}(X)$ is contained in a Borel subgroup and its derived length is $\leq n+1$.
